New Zealand secures first victory in T20I series against India

Match Summary

In the fourth T20 International match held in Auckland, New Zealand defeated India by 87 runs. Despite this loss, India maintains a 3-1 lead in the five-match series, having secured victories in the first three encounters.

New Zealand's Innings

New Zealand set a formidable target of 259 runs, driven by high-scoring performances from their middle-order batters:

  • Glenn Phillips: Scored 107 runs off 49 balls, featuring 6 fours and 9 sixes. He reached his century in 46 balls.
  • Michael Bracewell: Contributed an explosive 65 runs off 25 balls, including 4 fours and 6 sixes.
  • Early Struggles: India's Mayank Yadav provided early breakthroughs by dismissing Tim Seifert and Daryl Mitchell.

India's Response

Chasing a target of 259, the Indian batting lineup struggled to maintain the required run rate and was eventually restricted to 172 runs. Jacob Duffy played a pivotal role for the New Zealand bowling attack, taking 4 wickets to disrupt the Indian chase.

Series Context

While this match marks the first win for New Zealand in the current series, India still leads the series 3-1.
